editorial:
Imagine going back to the place where your worst childhood nightmare happened. That is exactly what you get here. You follow a woman who was the only survivor of a scary cult massacre from thirty years ago. She heads back to the old compound with a film crew to finally figure out why everyone died. The vibe is very creepy from the start, making you feel like something is watching them from the shadows. It starts as a slow mystery but quickly turns into a fight for survival as the group realizes they are not alone in those woods.

The acting is solid and the jump scares actually work to keep you on edge. While the middle part of the movie slows down a bit, the final act brings a crazy twist that changes everything. If you love stories about secret societies and supernatural threats, you will really dig this.
endingExplained: You find out that the cult was not just crazy, but was actually trying to keep a demon trapped. The twist is that the survivors were tricked into bringing the demon back into the world. In the final scenes, the main character has to fight the evil entity to stop it from spreading. Most of the crew dies, but she manages to survive after a scary battle, though the ending leaves you wondering if the evil is truly gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cult mysteries and ghost stories.
